what: While the panel is visible (10%), it rotates .08° per 1px of window scroll — 80° after 1000px, no curve, tied to scroll position so scrolling up reverses it. Its direct children (two big rings) rotate the same amount in the opposite direction, keeping their own shape (gradient direction) while orbiting around the panel center — the spot where a thick blue ring spanning two sections slowly rolls along

options.keep: If “off”, the child does not spin the opposite way and turns with the plate

from.where: recruit.html .rc-orbit (pairs of blue gradient rings behind the hero and in the About, Real and Know sections) — original recruiting site c-anime-circle (DEFAULT_SPEED .08)
